title: Chummer6 Horizons - The Table Remembers
global_magicfit_prompt: Cinematic cyberpunk tabletop product promo, rain-soaked neon sprawl, warm table light, AR campaign interface, dice and character sheets on a dark table, tactical UI overlays, readable horizon cards, polished product trailer, subtle handheld camera, no official game logos, no real brand logos, 16:9, 90 seconds.
negative_prompt: No official Shadowrun logos, no real corporate logos, no unreadable tiny text, no gore, no messy UI, no cartoon style, no exaggerated fantasy magic, no random weapon closeups, no ungrounded superhero visuals, no voyeuristic surveillance framing, no real-world targeting UI, no player scoring dashboard.
proof_constraints: 90 second minimum final duration with audio and video streams
captions contain one segment per scene
horizons are future lanes, not current feature promises
MagicFit render claim requires provider and scene receipts; otherwise label first-party motion storyboard

production_scenes.title: The Table Remembers
production_scenes.voiceover: A run does not end when the dice stop. Chummer6 carries builds, rules, places, briefings, and world state with proof.
production_scenes.on_screen_text: Chummer6 Horizons / Future lanes, not feature promises
production_scenes.magicfit_visual_prompt: Dark tabletop with dice, character sheets, laptop, and city map; neon AR lines connect runner, GM, rules, and campaign state.

production_scenes.title: Proof Before Promise
production_scenes.voiceover: These are horizon lanes, not claims that unfinished work is shipped. Current proof stays in charge.
production_scenes.on_screen_text: Proof boundary / Direction, not shelf truth
production_scenes.magicfit_visual_prompt: Trailer card pauses over live-proof receipts, download truth, status checkmarks, and a visible future-claim boundary.

production_scenes.title: Shared State Survives Device Churn
production_scenes.voiceover: NEXUS-PAN keeps the session calm when devices drift: reconnects, status, conflicts, and recovery you can understand.
production_scenes.on_screen_text: NEXUS-PAN / Shared state survives device churn
production_scenes.magicfit_visual_prompt: Player reconnects mid-session; multiple devices synchronize; red conflict warning resolves to green recovered state.

production_scenes.title: Build Mentor With Receipts
production_scenes.voiceover: ALICE checks builds before they break at the table: what is legal, what is fragile, and what really fits the role.
production_scenes.magicfit_visual_prompt: Two holographic runner build cards compare legality, role fit, budget, survivability, and cited receipt markers.

production_scenes.title: Change The Table. Keep The Trust.
production_scenes.voiceover: KARMA FORGE turns house rules into controlled packages: no pinned-message chaos, just changes with history and impact.
production_scenes.on_screen_text: KARMA FORGE / Change the table. Keep the trust.
production_scenes.magicfit_visual_prompt: GM activates a house-rule package; UI shows changed categories, affected runners, dependency warning, and rollback available.

production_scenes.title: Briefings And Dossiers Without Making Things Up
production_scenes.voiceover: JACKPOINT turns campaign truth into briefings, dossiers, and recaps: polished, spoiler-safe, and source-bound.
production_scenes.on_screen_text: JACKPOINT / Briefings and dossiers with source path
production_scenes.magicfit_visual_prompt: Post-run evidence board, dossier pages, recap cards, audio waveform, and player-safe versus GM-only spoiler toggle.

production_scenes.title: Mission Spaces, Made Legible
production_scenes.voiceover: RUNSITE makes dangerous places readable before they get loud: maps, routes, hotspots, and separate player and GM views.
production_scenes.magicfit_visual_prompt: Explorable safehouse blueprint with hotspots, camera cones, escape routes, hidden doors, and astral layer as GM-only overlay.

production_scenes.title: Living Campaign Truth Becomes Books
production_scenes.voiceover: RUNBOOK PRESS builds primers, handbooks, and campaign books from confirmed material instead of copy-paste from ten tools.
production_scenes.on_screen_text: RUNBOOK PRESS / Campaign truth becomes books
production_scenes.magicfit_visual_prompt: Campaign data assembles into a book layout: table of contents, district guide, GM appendix, PDF and web export cards.

production_scenes.title: Heat, Reactions, Aftermath - Bounded
production_scenes.voiceover: TABLE PULSE separates live pressure from private aftermath: reactions in play, coaching after play, always bounded.
production_scenes.on_screen_text: TABLE PULSE / Heat, reactions, aftermath - bounded
production_scenes.magicfit_visual_prompt: World heat rises during a scene; GM receives a reaction packet; cut to private after-action packet, no player score.

production_scenes.title: The City Remembers
production_scenes.voiceover: BLACK LEDGER lets the city remember. Runs create consequences, factions move, and new jobs grow from what actually happened.
production_scenes.magicfit_visual_prompt: Neon city map with district heat, faction moves, open jobs; completed run changes a marker and starts a news ticker.

production_scenes.title: Find The Table. Close The Loop.
production_scenes.voiceover: COMMUNITY HUB helps people reach the table: open runs, preflight, rules, roster, scheduling, and closeout without losing Chummer truth.
production_scenes.on_screen_text: COMMUNITY HUB / Find the table. Close the loop.
production_scenes.magicfit_visual_prompt: Player finds an open run, applies with runner dossier, preflight turns green, calendar handoff opens a neutral meeting door.

production_scenes.title: Nine Horizons. One Boundary.
production_scenes.voiceover: Nine horizons. One promise: keep the campaign explainable, from the first build to the world that remembers.
production_scenes.on_screen_text: Chummer6 Horizons / Build clearly. Run reliably. Carry the campaign forward.
production_scenes.magicfit_visual_prompt: All nine horizon cards orbit the tabletop; camera rises as table becomes a city map and resolves into Chummer6 interface.
